name: Three Kisses Baby Tee
note:
A fitted white baby tee with three red kiss prints down the front. The simple graphic brings a playful pop of colour while the back stays clean and plain.

180 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton. Pre-shrunk and bio-washed, with a ribbed crew neckline and double-stitched construction. Fitted baby-tee silhouette.
